steps.en: Unzip the release, run Magpie, and pick a scaling mode such as FSR or Anime4K
steps.zh: 解压发布包运行 Magpie，选一种缩放模式，如 FSR 或 Anime4K

steps.en: Run the game or app windowed at its native (best) resolution
steps.zh: 让游戏或程序以原生（最佳）分辨率窗口化运行

steps.en: Focus that window and press the scale hotkey
steps.zh: 切到那个窗口，按缩放快捷键

steps.en: Captures the window's frames through Windows Graphics Capture, no injection
steps.zh: 通过 Windows Graphics Capture 抓取窗口画面，不注入进程

steps.en: Runs your HLSL effect chain on the GPU to enlarge each frame
steps.zh: 在显卡上跑 HLSL 效果链，逐帧放大

steps.en: Shows the result in a topmost window and maps your cursor back to the source
steps.zh: 在置顶窗口显示结果，并把光标映射回原窗口

value.en: A small, blurry-when-stretched window plays full-screen and sharper, and nothing is injected into the game
value.zh: 拉伸就糊的小窗口变成全屏且更清晰的画面，游戏进程里什么都没注入

sources: https://github.com/Blinue/Magpie README (Download link to releases, Hints: DPI override and built-in best resolution, system requirements)
docs/Comparison of capture methods.md (Graphics Capture recommended default)
docs/Built-in effects.md and docs/MagpieFX (EN).md (HLSL effects, effects folder)
src/Magpie.Core/CursorManager.cpp (maps source cursor position to scaled position)
